title_en: Why you can be closed out before your margin hits zero
title_zh: 保证金为什么还没归零，就可能出局？
goal_en: Tell initial margin, maintenance margin, equity and available balance apart.
goal_zh: 区分初始保证金、维持保证金、权益与可用余额。

shots.visual_en: The margin gauge still shows a little left; Sam blocks a liquidation warning with one hand.
shots.visual_zh: 保证金仪表还剩一点，小白挡住强平警告。

lines.en: There's still money there. Why won't it let me keep waiting?
lines.zh: 还有余额，怎么就不让我继续等？

shots.visual_en: Brand open (3 s): official NexuAlpha logo mark + wordmark (imported SVG, never redrawn, proportions locked) eases in centre-left; series title, 'S2 · E20' and the episode title slide in beside it; fixed short brand sting. Nexubo pops up from the bottom edge with a squash-and-stretch landing, antenna blue.
shots.visual_zh: 品牌片头（3秒）：正式标志图形＋文字标（导入原始SVG，不重画、不变比例）淡入；旁边显示系列名、“第2季 · 第20集”与本集标题；固定短音效。小纳从画面下沿弹出落地，天线蓝灯。
onscreen_text_en: Why you can be closed out before your margin hits zero
onscreen_text_zh: 保证金为什么还没归零，就可能出局？

shots.visual_en: Four transparent boxes: initial margin, unrealised P&L, current equity, maintenance requirement.
shots.visual_zh: 四个透明格子：初始保证金、未实现盈亏、当前权益、维持要求。

lines.en: You need initial margin to open a position. While it's open, you must also meet the maintenance margin requirement. What you put in at the start isn't how much buffer you'll always have.
lines.zh: 开仓时需要初始保证金；持仓期间，还必须满足维持保证金要求。初始放了多少，不等于之后一直有多少风险缓冲。

shots.visual_en: Teaching example: initial margin 100, unrealised loss 20, simplified equity 80. Fees ignored.
shots.visual_zh: 教学初始保证金100，未实现亏损20，简化权益变成80；费用暂不计。

lines.en: Say the initial margin is 100 and the position is down 20. Ignoring everything else, the equity is now 80. If the price keeps moving against you, the buffer keeps shrinking.
lines.zh: 假设初始保证金是一百，仓位浮亏二十，忽略其他项目，相关权益就只剩八十。价格继续不利变化，可用缓冲也会继续缩小。

onscreen_text_en: Fees ignored · Teaching model · not any exchange's real rules
onscreen_text_zh: 暂不计费用 · 教学模型 · 非任何交易所真实规则

shots.visual_en: The maintenance requirement is drawn as a warning line that moves with position size and rules; the equity line approaches it.
shots.visual_zh: 维持要求画成会随仓位和规则变化的警戒线，权益线接近它。

lines.en: When equity gets close to the platform's maintenance level, the risk system may step in. It doesn't have to wait for zero. It depends on the account type, margin mode and product rules.
lines.zh: 当权益接近平台要求的维持水平，风险系统就可能介入；不一定等到全部归零。具体看哪种账户、保证金模式和产品规则。

shots.visual_en: Adding margin makes the buffer bigger, and the total 'money at risk' grows too.
shots.visual_zh: 追加保证金后缓冲变大，同时“投入风险的资金”总量也上升。

lines.en: So if I keep adding money, I'm safe?
lines.zh: 那我一直补钱就安全了？

lines.en: Adding money doesn't change the price direction, and it doesn't guarantee you won't be liquidated. It can pull more money into the same risk.
lines.zh: 补钱不改变价格方向，也不保证不会被强平。它可能把更多资金带入同一笔风险。

shots.visual_en: Question card: 'Are initial margin and maintenance margin the same thing?'
shots.visual_zh: 题目：初始保证金和维持保证金，是不是一个概念？

lines.en: No. One is about opening the position. The other is about keeping it open.
lines.zh: 不是，一个关乎开仓条件，一个关乎持仓维持要求。

lines.en: Check equity first, then how far it is from the warning line.
lines.zh: 先看权益，再看它离警戒线多远。

shots.visual_en: End hook (4 s): quick teaser of the next problem — a single striking image from the next episode's opening, frozen on the moment of doubt; Sam reacts, Nexubo's antenna blinks amber. Text card with the hook line.
shots.visual_zh: 片尾钩子（4秒）：下一集开场矛盾的一个定格画面，停在“犯疑问”的瞬间；小白反应，小纳天线琥珀灯闪。字卡显示钩子台词。

lines.en: Put 100 in a box. Is the other 900 safe forever? Next: isolated margin.
lines.zh: 把一百装进小盒子，另外九百就永远安全吗？下一集：逐仓。

onscreen_text_zh: 把一百装进小盒子，另外九百就永远安全吗？下一集：逐仓。

shots.visual_zh: 品牌片尾（4秒）：标志图形＋文字标、系列名、“先看懂，再动手。”、小号品牌标语“全球交易所，一个官方入口”；“nexualpha.com”为识别文字（可点击入口在网页）。小纳挥手，天线绿灯。

page_cta.line_en: Fill in the simplified equity in the margin risk simulator below. Teaching model only.
page_cta.line_zh: 在下方保证金风险模拟器里填出简化权益，仅为教学模型。
page_cta.placement: directly beside / under the video player; never gates the lesson

exercise.task_en: Given initial margin 100, unrealised loss 20 and no fees, enter the simplified equity of 80, and spot which fields change.
exercise.task_zh: 给定初始100、浮亏20、暂不计费，填写简化权益80；识别变动字段。
exercise.answer_en: Equity 80. The maintenance requirement is calculated by product rules and can't be assumed equal to the initial margin.
exercise.answer_zh: 权益80；维持要求需另按产品规则计算，不能固定认为等于初始保证金。

red_lines: Never draw 'liquidation only when your money hits zero' ｜ 不可画“本金归零才触发强平”
Never mix up available balance, equity and position value ｜ 不将可用余额、权益、仓位价值混为一谈
Futures examples are USDT-margined linear perpetuals only; never mix in coin-margined, options or delivery formulas ｜ 合约示例限USDT计价线性永续，不混入币本位、期权和交割合约公式
Futures episode: no conversion card, no partner name, no invite code, no 'open position' button; page CTA = none ｜ 合约集：不放转化卡、不出现合作平台名和邀请码、不画“开仓”按钮；网页CTA为none
Logo mark + wordmark top-left on every shot, official SVG only ｜ 每个镜头左上角都有正式标志图形＋文字标，只用原始SVG
